name: Universal TV Text Spacing
description: Increases letter and word spacing for better readability at TV viewing distance

params.css: p, li, td, th, span, a, div, label, dd, dt, blockquote { letter-spacing: 0.03em !important; word-spacing: 0.08em !important; } h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 { letter-spacing: 0.01em !important; word-spacing: 0.05em !important; } article p, main p, .content p { line-height: 1.8 !important; margin-bottom: 1.2em !important; }
